title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning

mechanism.domainTask: Reflective prompt optimization for modular compound-AI systems, with code-optimization and adversarial-search extensions
mechanism.populationDetail: The candidate pool starts with the base system and adds minibatch-improving prompt variants; ancestry is recorded but selection uses a flat pool and Pareto frontier, not a maintained tree population.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The selection frontier retains candidates that are best on at least one validation instance and removes dominated candidates; there are no descriptor-defined behavior cells.
mechanism.replacementDetail: A candidate is admitted only if it improves on its parent on the sampled minibatch; Pareto filtering separately prunes dominated candidates from the selection frontier.
mechanism.generationDetail: Base GEPA performs one-parent reflective prompt mutation; optional GEPA+Merge combines complementary module prompts from two descendants sharing a common ancestor.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Scalar task scores are tracked per validation instance for Pareto selection; trace text is supplied to the reflection model for targeted prompt updates.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Reflective mutation chooses one candidate from the Pareto frontier; optional Merge chooses two compatible descendants with a shared ancestor. The field count is unclear because the two mechanisms differ.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/GEPA Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: The GEPA+Merge variant has two parents while reflective mutation has one; exact generation-operator allocation is not specified. Pareto objectives are per-instance task scores (vector for selection), not pairwise preferences. Survey cites GEPA in prompt, feedback, staged evaluation, model-setting, application and framework discussions, but not currently in Population, generation mechanism/selection, or explore-exploit subsections. Reflection-LM identity is not separately itemized.
